text:
Senior Backend Engineer — 9 years

Summary
Backend engineer focused on distributed systems and developer platforms. I design, build and run high-throughput services in C# and .NET on Azure, and I have spent the last three years as the technical lead of a five-person platform team. Comfortable owning a service from design review to on-call.

Experience
Northwind Logistics — Senior Software Engineer, Platform (2022–present)
- Led the migration of 14 order-routing services from a shared VM fleet to Azure Kubernetes Service, cutting p95 latency from 820 ms to 190 ms.
- Designed an event-driven shipment pipeline on Azure Service Bus and PostgreSQL that processes 40M events a day with exactly-once side effects.
- Introduced Terraform for all platform infrastructure and wrote the module library other teams now use.
- Mentor three engineers; run the team's architecture review and incident postmortems.

Contoso Payments — Software Engineer II → Senior (2018–2022)
- Built the ledger reconciliation service in .NET Core and SQL Server; owned its on-call rotation.
- Rewrote the settlement batch job as a streaming service, reducing nightly runtime from 6 hours to 25 minutes.
- Added OpenTelemetry tracing across 30 services and set the SLOs the team still reports on.

Fabrikam — Software Engineer (2016–2018)
- Built REST APIs in ASP.NET MVC and a Redis-backed rate limiter used by the public API.

Skills
C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Go (production services), PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Functions, Cosmos DB), Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, OpenTelemetry, gRPC, GitHub Actions.

Education
BSc Computer Science, University of Texas at Austin.
